macros.name: pgfmathaddtocount
macros.doc: Adds the truncated value of ⟨expression⟩ to the TeX ⟨count register⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathaddtocounter
macros.doc: Adds the truncated value of ⟨expression⟩ to ⟨counter⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathaddtolength
macros.doc: Adds the value of ⟨expression⟩ to the TeX ⟨register⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathanglebetweenlines
macros.doc: Returns the clockwise angle between a line going through p1 and q1 and a line going through p2 and q2 .

macros.name: pgfmathanglebetweenpoints
macros.doc: Returns the angle of a line from ⟨p⟩ to ⟨q⟩ relative to a line going straight right from ⟨p⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathapproxequalto
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult 1.0 if |⟨x⟩−⟨y⟩|< 0.0001, but 0.0 otherwise.

macros.name: pgfmatharray
macros.doc: This accesses the array x at the index y. The array must begin and end with braces (e.g., {1,2,3,4}) and array indexing starts at 0.

macros.name: pgfmathatantwo
macros.doc: Arctangent of y ÷ x in degrees.

macros.name: pgfmathbasetobase
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the result of converting ⟨number⟩ from base ⟨base-1⟩ to base ⟨base-2⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathbasetoBase
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the result of converting ⟨number⟩ from base ⟨base-1⟩ to base ⟨base-2⟩. Alphabetic digits in ⟨number⟩ can be upper or lower case, but any resulting alphabetic digits are in upper case.

macros.name: pgfmathbasetodec
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the result of converting ⟨number⟩ from base ⟨base⟩ to base 10.

macros.name: pgfmathcosec
macros.doc: Cosecant of x. By employing the r operator, x can be in radians.

macros.name: pgfmathdeclarefunction
macros.doc: This will set up the parser to recognize a function called ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathdeclarerandomlist
macros.doc: This creates a list of items with the name ⟨list name⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathdectobase
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the result of converting ⟨number⟩ from base 10 to base ⟨base⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathdectoBase
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the result of converting ⟨number⟩ from base 10 to base ⟨base⟩. Any resulting alphabetic digits are in upper case.

macros.name: pgfmathe
macros.doc: Returns the value 2.718281828.

macros.name: pgfmathfloatcreate
macros.doc: Defines \pgfmathresult as the floating point number encoded by ⟨flags⟩, ⟨mantissa⟩ and ⟨exponent⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathfloatgetflags
macros.doc: Extracts the flags of ⟨x⟩ into the count register ⟨flagscount⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathfloatgetflagstomacro
macros.doc: Extracts the flags of ⟨x⟩ into the macro ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathfloatqparsenumber
macros.doc: The same as \pgfmathfloatparsenumber, but does not perform sanity checking.

macros.name: pgfmathfloatroundzerofill
macros.doc: A variant of \pgfmathfloatround produces always the same number of digits after the period (it includes zeros if necessary).

macros.name: pgfmathfloattofixed
macros.doc: Converts a number in floating point representation to a fixed point number.

macros.name: pgfmathfloattoint
macros.doc: Converts a number from low-level floating point representation to an integer (by truncating the fractional part).

macros.name: pgfmathfloattomacro
macros.doc: Extracts the flags of a floating point number ⟨x⟩ to ⟨flagsmacro⟩, the mantissa to ⟨mantissamacro⟩ and the exponent to ⟨exponentmacro⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathfloattoregisters
macros.doc: Takes a floating point number ⟨x⟩ as input and writes flags to count register ⟨flagscount⟩, mantissa to dimen register ⟨mantissadimen⟩ and exponent to count register ⟨exponentcount⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathfloattoregisterstok
macros.doc: A variant of \pgfmathfloattoregisters which writes the mantissa into a token register. It maintains the full input precision.

macros.name: pgfmathfloattosci
macros.doc: Converts a number from low-level floating point representation to scientific format, 1.234e4.

macros.name: pgfmathfloatvalueof
macros.doc: Expands a number from low-level floating point representation to scientific format, 1.234e4.

macros.name: pgfmathgreater
macros.doc: This returns 1 if x > y and 0 otherwise.

macros.name: pgfmathifisint
macros.doc: A command which does the same check as int detect, but it invokes ⟨true code⟩ if the ⟨number constant⟩ actually is an integer and the ⟨false code⟩ if not.

macros.name: pgfmathiseven
macros.doc: Returns 1 if the integer part of x is even.

macros.name: pgfmathisprime
macros.doc: Returns 1 if the integer part of x is prime.

macros.name: pgfmathlogten
macros.doc: An approximation for log10 (x).

macros.name: pgfmathlogtwo
macros.doc: An approximation for log2 (x).

macros.name: pgfmathnotequal
macros.doc: This returns 0 if x = y and 1 otherwise.

macros.name: pgfmathnotgreater
macros.doc: This returns 1 if x ≤ y and 0 otherwise.

macros.name: pgfmathnotless
macros.doc: This returns 1 if x ≥ y and 0 otherwise.

macros.name: pgfmathprintnumber
macros.doc: Generates pretty-printed output for the (real) number ⟨x⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathprintnumberto
macros.doc: Returns the resulting number into ⟨macro⟩ instead of typesetting it directly.

macros.name: pgfmathqparse
macros.doc: This macro is similar to \pgfmathparse: it parses ⟨expression⟩ and returns the result in the macro \pgfmathresult.

macros.name: pgfmathrandom
macros.doc: This function takes zero, one or two arguments. If there are zero arguments, a uniform random number between 0 and 1 is generated.

macros.name: pgfmathrandominteger
macros.doc: This defines ⟨macro⟩ as a pseudo-randomly generated integer from the range ⟨minimum⟩ to ⟨maximum⟩ (inclusive).

macros.name: pgfmathrandomitem
macros.doc: Select an item from a random list ⟨list name⟩. The selected item is placed in ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathredeclarefunction
macros.doc: This command redefines the \pgfmath⟨function name⟩@ macro with the new ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathroundto
macros.doc: Rounds a fixed point number to prescribed precision and writes the result to \pgfmathresult.

macros.name: pgfmathroundtozerofill
macros.doc: A variant of \pgfmathroundto which always uses a fixed number of digits behind the period. It fills missing digits with zeros.

macros.name: pgfmathscalar
macros.doc: This function is the identity function on its input, but it will reset the TeX-if \ifpgfmathunitsdeclared.

macros.name: pgfmathsetbasenumberlength
macros.doc: Sets the number of digits in the result of a base conversion to ⟨integer⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathsetcount
macros.doc: Sets the value of the TeX ⟨count register⟩, to the truncated value specified by ⟨expression⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathsetcounter
macros.doc: Sets the value of the LaTeX ⟨counter⟩ to the truncated value specified by ⟨expression⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathsetlength
macros.doc: Basically, this command sets the length of the TeX ⟨register⟩ to the value specified by ⟨expression⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathsetlengthmacro
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the value of ⟨expression⟩ in points.

macros.name: pgfmathsetmacro
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the value of ⟨expression⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathsetseed
macros.doc: Explicitly sets the seed for the pseudo-random number generator.

macros.name: pgfmathtodigitlist
macros.doc: This command converts ⟨number⟩ into a comma-separated list of digits and stores the result in ⟨macro⟩.

macros.name: pgfmathtruncatemacro
macros.doc: Defines ⟨macro⟩ as the truncated value of ⟨expression⟩.
